card.essence: A powerful remedy for dyspeptic complaints centred on the stomach, especially in the aged. The cardinal feature is a sensation of a lump (as if a hard-boiled egg) lodged at the cardiac end of stomach, with constriction above the pit. Most symptoms associate with gastric disturbance. Functional heart symptoms may accompany. Characteristically worse after eating.
